layer_definitions.label: Seasonal Framework
layer_definitions.description: Uses the latest cardinal solar ingress before the forecast time as the broader weather backdrop.

layer_definitions.label: Lunar Trigger
layer_definitions.description: Uses the latest lunar phase before the forecast time as the shorter trigger layer.

layer_definitions.label: Locality Proxy
layer_definitions.description: Uses angle emphasis plus horizon/meridian target-zone intersection proxies until a fuller weather-map runtime is implemented.

watters.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events

green_carter.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States

weather_framework.label: Ingress Plus Lunar Phase Framework
weather_framework.summary: The weather seed engine preserves the benchmark-first framework that forecasts use the latest ingress for the seasonal backdrop and the latest lunar phase for shorter-term activation.

weather_locality_proxy.label: Locality Proxy Only
weather_locality_proxy.summary: The first runtime does not implement a full weather map engine; it uses angular path proxies plus horizon/meridian target-zone intersections as an explicitly limited locality layer.

weather_eclipse_deferred.label: Bounded Eclipse Decision
weather_eclipse_deferred.summary: Eclipse timing remains deferred in the live weather runtime until locality and weak-family discrimination improve enough to justify family-bounded eclipse scoring.

flood_risk.label: Flood Risk Family
flood_risk.summary: Flood interpretation preserves excess-water, flood, flash-flood, and prolonged heavy-precipitation logic instead of generic rain output.

hurricane_pressure.label: Hurricane Pressure Family
hurricane_pressure.summary: Hurricane interpretation preserves tropical-storm and landfall pressure as a distinct family with wind-and-moisture emphasis.

severe_convective_pressure.label: Severe Convective Family
severe_convective_pressure.summary: Thunderstorm, hail, and tornado examples stay grouped as a severe-convection family until a larger runtime benchmark base justifies narrower splits.

wind_event_pressure.label: Wind Event Family
wind_event_pressure.summary: Wind interpretation preserves Mercury and front-driven wind logic as a separate family, including named regional wind regimes.
